title: THOR-NeuroBench Challenge 2026: Motor Imagery BCI Benchmarking
summary: The THOR Neuromorphic Commons hosts the inaugural THOR-NeuroBench Challenge (March–July 2026) to benchmark neuromorphic models for classifying motor imagery from EEG signals. Participants must convert continuous OpenBMI dataset data into discrete spike trains compatible with event-driven architectures, evaluating performance via Synaptic Operations rather than standard MAC counts. The challenge targets applications in wearable decoders for wheelchairs and prosthetics. A $1,000 prize pool is sponsored by the Edge AI Foundation.
tldr: The THOR-NeuroBench Challenge 2026 benchmarks neuromorphic models on converting OpenBMI EEG data into spike trains to classify motor imagery using SynOps metrics for wearable BCI applications.
